verdict.rationale: Gusto has a confirmed llms.txt file (HTTP 200 with structured guide index) plus extensive .md-formatted docs pages, and additionally documents an official MCP server (both a dev-assistant MCP for API/code docs and a remote MCP server for account data) explicitly designed for AI agent consumption. This directly satisfies the story of pointing an agent at agent-oriented docs/llms.txt. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that agents reliably parse/use these docs in practice beyond first-party claims.
